newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices gained on consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices gained on consumer demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices rose modestly on increased consumer demand and higher enquiries on Monday, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 moved up by 2/5 rupees to 1,280/1,325 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 7/10 rupees to 1,320/1,375 rupees.
"Limited offerings by millers has curtailed arrivals of sugar from the mills to the market," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery remained steady at 1,210/1,220 rupees per quintal amid limited outstation interest.
